enhancements.name: Fine-tuning on bias-audited shortlists
enhancements.how: Once the bias audit clears, fine-tune only on shortlists audited for bias, so past recruiter bias is not learned.

source.title: EU AI Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/1689), Article 10: Data and data governance

enhancements.name: Bias-check agent for each model version
enhancements.how: For each new model version, an agent reruns the bias checks and blocks release until the independent auditor signs off.

source.title: MIT AI Risk Mitigation Taxonomy (draft), 3.1 Testing & Auditing

enhancements.name: Missed-candidate sampling agent
enhancements.how: Each day an agent samples rejected applications and flags strong candidates the ranking missed for a recruiter to check.

source.title: MIT AI Risk Mitigation Taxonomy (draft), 3.5 Post-deployment Monitoring

enhancements.name: Recruiter review of every rejection
enhancements.how: The named recruiter reviews each rejection below the cut-off and records why before the candidate is told.

source.title: EU AI Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/1689), Article 26: Obligations of deployers of high-risk AI systems
